verdict.rationale: Marlin's own documented capability is autonomous AI research that produces deep insights and structured strategic options (suggestions), delivered as reports and slides. The evidence describes it working from web-gathered and primary-source information on a research topic, not from the user's own data. All claims are vendor-only. Missing for 10: evidence of analyzing the user's own uploaded or connected data, interactive in-product insight surfacing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Rather than merely aggregating information, it compares and evaluates multiple hypotheses to provide deep insights.
delivers structured strategic options ready for executive review
Expect zero wasted effort, just pure, compounding high-value insights.
repeatedly forming hypotheses, gathering information, navigating the web, and resolving contradictions on its own
